scripts.tests: npm run build && LANGWRIGHT_CONFIG=langwright.config.ts playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run unit && npm run tests && npm run audit:high
scripts.quality:codeql: rm -rf /tmp/langwright-codeql-db /tmp/langwright-codeql-results.sarif && codeql pack download codeql/javascript-queries@2.3.10 && codeql database create /tmp/langwright-codeql-db --language=javascript-typescript --source-root . --command="npm run build" --overwrite && codeql database analyze /tmp/langwright-codeql-db codeql/javascript-queries@2.3.10:codeql-suites/javascript-security-and-quality.qls --format=sarif-latest --output=/tmp/langwright-codeql-results.sarif && node scripts/codeql-quality-check.js /tmp/langwright-codeql-results.sarif
